This is strong evidence against tolerating investigative journalism and against keeping neutral institutions outside political retaliation.","question_ids":["4B.5","4B.3"]},{"title":"Democratic Republic of Congo: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/democratic-republic-congo/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the judiciary, especially the Constitutional Court, is often seen as corrupt and politically manipulated, and that military courts are subject to interference from high-ranking military personnel. That is the clearest evidence of entrenchment behavior in 2024 and cuts directly against avoiding personality-cult or regime-capture dynamics.","question_ids":["4B.5","4B.1","4B.2"]}]}
